verdict.rationale: Hightouch documents an official MCP server that connects AI assistants directly to its marketing stack, supporting audience creation, sync management, journey design, and creative generation via natural language, with RBAC scoping. This is corroborated by both docs and a runtime probe confirming the MCP docs page and agent-oriented llms.txt. Missing for 10: independent hands-on third-party review of the MCP server in actual use.
